main.title: We Build Any Digital Product
main.description:
At CodeNation Studio, we don’t just develop software, we co-create technology solutions that solve real problems and drive meaningful impact. As a true custom software factory, we partner with companies and startups to turn their ideas into robust, scalable, market-ready digital products.

Whether you need an e-commerce platform, a mobile application, a SaaS product, or an internal management system, our team of developers, designers, and software architects supports you at every stage — from requirements definition to launch and continuous product evolution.

explanation.title: Custom Software Factory
explanation.description:
We build end-to-end digital solutions, from concept to scalable product. Web applications, mobile apps, e-commerce platforms, and enterprise systems developed with quality, speed, and an agile mindset.

We apply engineering best practices and modern technologies to ensure fast delivery, clean code, and an exceptional user experience.

inhouse.title: Why Develop With Us
inhouse.description:
• 100% Custom Solutions – Every product is designed and built around your business goals.

• Agile & Continuous Delivery – We work in sprints with visible progress from day one.

• Modern & Scalable Technologies – We use up-to-date tech stacks and clean architectures.

• Multidisciplinary Team – Development, UX/UI, and QA working together seamlessly.

• Results-Driven Approach – We create solutions that deliver real business value.

subcategories.title: We build digital solutions that drive efficiency, growth, and competitive advantage.

allsubcategories.description: Modern, responsive, and SEO-optimized websites with dynamic, manageable content.

allsubcategories.title: E-Commerce Development
allsubcategories.description: Custom online stores with payment gateway integration, inventory management, logistics, and digital marketing tools..

allsubcategories.title: Mobile Applications
allsubcategories.description: Native (iOS/Android) or cross-platform (Flutter/React Native) apps with intuitive interfaces and high performance.

allsubcategories.title: Custom Platforms & Systems
allsubcategories.description: B2B solutions, dashboards, internal CRMs, marketplaces, and lightweight ERP systems tailored to your business.

allsubcategories.title: Software Modernization
allsubcategories.description: We transform legacy systems into modern, secure, and maintainable applications.

allsubcategories.title: APIs & Integrations
allsubcategories.description: We build robust APIs to connect your product with third-party services (payments, messaging, ERP, and more).

alltestimonials.message: From the very beginning, we felt they truly listened to our ideas. They didn’t offer a generic solution, but something specifically designed for our business model. The process was clear, collaborative, and they always made us feel part of the development. Today, the system saves us time every single day.

We had previously worked with tools that promised a lot but adapted very little. This time was different. They understood how our team operates and built a platform that truly reflects the way we work. You can tell when software is genuinely custom-built.

More than a vendor, we found a true technology partner. They were always available to answer questions and suggest improvements. The result was an intuitive, stable product ready to scale with us. Working with such a committed team gave us real peace of mind.

main.title: Accelerate Your Startup from Day One
main.description:
At CodeNation Studio, we know startup success doesn’t come from launching a perfect product, it comes from validating your value proposition fast. That’s why we specialize in agile MVP (Minimum Viable Product) development, helping you test your business model with minimal time, cost, and risk.

We work closely with you to define the core features, craft a compelling user experience, and build a functional version of your product in just weeks. This allows you to gather real user feedback, iterate quickly, and make strategic decisions based on data not assumptions.

explanation.title: Launch, Validate, and Scale with Intelligence
explanation.description:
Validate your idea in weeks not months. We transform your concept into a functional Minimum Viable Product, ready to test in the market, attract early users, and capture investor attention. All built with a Lean Startup mindset and cutting-edge technology.

Through our work inside startup incubators and from our own experience being accelerated by programs like Endeavor, Emprelatam, Reto Zapopan, and CodeLaunch — we understand what truly makes an MVP stand out. We know which elements are essential to attract both users and investors.

inhouse.title: Why Build Your MVP With Us
inhouse.description:
• Fast Launch (4–8 Weeks) – A fully functional MVP delivered quickly, without compromising quality.

• Lean Approach – We focus only on what’s essential to validate your core hypothesis.

• Startup Experience – We’ve been through the journey ourselves. We understand the challenges.

• Scalable Architecture – Built to grow from day one.

• Integrated Metrics – Track usage, retention, and conversion from the very beginning.

subcategories.title: How We Build Your MVP: With What It Takes to Compete from Day One

allsubcategories.title: Scope Definition
allsubcategories.description: We identify the minimum set of features required to properly validate your idea.

allsubcategories.title: UX/UI Design
allsubcategories.description: We craft intuitive, engaging interfaces designed to create impact from the very first interaction.

allsubcategories.title: Full-Stack Development
allsubcategories.description: We build a fully functional product: frontend, backend, and database included.

allsubcategories.title: Testing & Launch
allsubcategories.description: We conduct rigorous testing and support you through a smooth market launch.

allsubcategories.title: Analytics Integration
allsubcategories.description: Google Analytics setup, custom events, and conversion and retention tracking from day one.

allsubcategories.title: Post-Launch Support
allsubcategories.description: We help you iterate based on real user feedback and prepare for your next growth stage or funding round.

explanation.fewWords: Abordamos cada proyecto con una visión clara.
explanation.title: Nos gusta eliminar el “relleno” y diseñar sitios web hermosos, fáciles de usar y funcionales.
explanation.description: No solo construimos sitios web bonitos. En MadeByShape entendemos todos los aspectos de un sitio exitoso, desde el diseño, el desarrollo web y las pruebas, hasta el SEO y el hosting. Adaptamos nuestro servicio al cliente y a los requerimientos del proyecto.

inhouse.title: Manejamos cada proyecto internamente, no subcontratamos.
inhouse.description: Somos un equipo sólido de 16 personas, sabemos cuánta carga de trabajo podemos asumir y avisamos a los clientes si habrá algún retraso. Cada proyecto web que realizamos se produce internamente, sin subcontratación. Si sentimos que no somos la opción adecuada para tu proyecto, utilizaremos nuestra experiencia en la industria digital para recomendarte una agencia adecuada. Nuestro equipo de diseñadores de marca, diseñadores web y redactores de contenido trabaja en conjunto para ofrecerte la solución perfecta.

main.title: Unlock the Power of AI for Your Business
main.description:
Artificial intelligence is no longer science fiction it’s a strategic tool to scale, automate, and personalize your products. At CodeNation Studio, we don’t apply AI just because it’s trendy; we implement it with purpose. Integrating AI into your product means delivering smarter experiences, reducing operational costs, and making proactive decisions powered by data.

From intelligent chatbots to advanced automation and predictive analytics, we build AI solutions that enhance user experience, streamline processes, and create a real competitive advantage.

explanation.title: The Impact of AI on Your Business
explanation.description:
• Intelligent Automation – Bots that reduce manual work and make context-aware decisions.

• Advanced Personalization – Accurate recommendations that create unique user experiences.

• Predictive Decisions – Anticipate behaviors, failures, and trends using machine learning.

• Seamless Integration – We implement AI without rebuilding your entire product.

• Ethical and Secure AI – Privacy, transparency, and human oversight built in.

inhouse.title: Transform Your Product with Strategic Intelligence
inhouse.description:
We work with pre-trained models (such as LLMs) and custom models, integrating them securely and efficiently into your technology stack while ensuring system privacy and scalability.

From chatbots and recommendation engines to predictive platforms, we turn real business needs into robust, scalable, and sustainable technology.

alltexts.title: LLM-Powered Chatbots & Virtual Assistants
alltexts.description: Conversational assistants that understand complex queries, maintain context, and solve real problems. They integrate easily into websites, apps, or WhatsApp, connecting with your internal systems to provide useful and actionable responses.

alltexts.title: Intelligent Recommendation Systems
alltexts.description: Personalized recommendation engines that analyze user behavior, preferences, and historical data to suggest products, content, or services with high accuracy across e-commerce, digital platforms, and B2B environments.

alltexts.title: AI-Powered Process Automation (Hybrid AI)
alltexts.description: We combine RPA with AI models to automate entire workflows such as customer support, document classification, data validation, or onboarding—reducing operational time and minimizing manual errors.

alltexts.title: Predictive Analytics & Forecasting
alltexts.description: We build models that anticipate sales trends, churn, preventive maintenance, and user behavior—helping you make data-driven decisions instead of relying only on intuition.

alltexts.title: Natural Language Processing (NLP)
alltexts.description: We apply NLP techniques to extract insights from large volumes of text, analyze sentiment, categorize information, and generate automatic summaries that support faster and smarter decision-making.

alltexts.title: Applied Generative AI
alltexts.description: We implement generative models for text, images, or code to optimize internal processes, accelerate content creation, and enhance user experiences with innovative and scalable solutions.
